_about: Public-domain John Kershaw (1792-1870), Strict Baptist minister of Hope Chapel, Rochdale, for the Word Hoard: Memorials of the Mercies of a Covenant God while travelling through the wilderness, his autobiography (1876), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 50 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

kershaw-memorials: Memorials of the mercies of a covenant God while travelling through the wilderness being the autobiography of John Kershaw, of Rochdale, to which is added, an account of his last days, by his widow (London : [s.n, 1876)

_excluded.kershaw-other: Every other Kershaw in the catalogue is another person (chemistry, fuel, Charleston history)
